project.description: Clona un repositorio Flutter y ejecuta un comando configurable.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: REPO_URL
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: URL git del repositorio. Si se deja vacia usa JENKINS_JOB_REPO_URL.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: GIT_BRANCH
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Rama a clonar. Si se deja vacia usa JENKINS_JOB_BRANCH.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: GIT_DEPTH
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Profundidad del clone. Usa 0 para clone completo.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: JOB_COMMAND
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Comando shell a ejecutar dentro del repo clonado.

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: CLEAN_WORKSPACE
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: Elimina el clone anterior antes de ejecutar.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/usr/bin/env bash set -euo pipefail
REPO_URL="${REPO_URL:-${JENKINS_JOB_REPO_URL:-}}" GIT_BRANCH="${GIT_BRANCH:-${JENKINS_JOB_BRANCH:-main}}" GIT_DEPTH="${GIT_DEPTH:-${JENKINS_GIT_DEPTH:-1}}" JOB_COMMAND="${JOB_COMMAND:-${JENKINS_JOB_COMMAND:-flutter pub get && flutter test}}" CLEAN_WORKSPACE="${CLEAN_WORKSPACE:-true}"
if [[ -z "${REPO_URL}" ]]; then echo "REPO_URL or JENKINS_JOB_REPO_URL must be set." exit 2 fi
export HOME="${JENKINS_HOME:-${HOME}}" mkdir -p "${HOME}/.ssh"
ssh_dir="${WORKSPACE}/.ssh" rm -rf "${ssh_dir}" mkdir -p "${ssh_dir}" chmod 700 "${ssh_dir}"
askpass_script="${ssh_dir}/ssh-askpass.sh" temp_key_file="" key_file="" cleanup() { if [[ -n "${SSH_AGENT_PID:-}" ]]; then ssh-agent -k >/dev/null fi if [[ -n "${temp_key_file:-}" && -f "${temp_key_file}" ]]; then rm -f "${temp_key_file}" fi if [[ -f "${askpass_script}" ]]; then rm -f "${askpass_script}" fi } trap cleanup EXIT
ssh_options=(-o "StrictHostKeyChecking=${JENKINS_GIT_STRICT_HOST_KEY_CHECKING:-accept-new}") if [[ -n "${JENKINS_GIT_KNOWN_HOSTS:-}" ]]; then known_hosts_file="${ssh_dir}/known_hosts" printf '%s\n' "${JENKINS_GIT_KNOWN_HOSTS}" > "${known_hosts_file}" chmod 600 "${known_hosts_file}" ssh_options+=(-o "UserKnownHostsFile=${known_hosts_file}") fi
if [[ -n "${JENKINS_GIT_SSH_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE:-}" ]]; then if [[ ! -f "${JENKINS_GIT_SSH_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE}" ]]; then echo "JENKINS_GIT_SSH_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE points to a missing file: ${JENKINS_GIT_SSH_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE}" exit 3 fi chmod 600 "${JENKINS_GIT_SSH_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE}" 2>/dev/null || true key_file="${JENKINS_GIT_SSH_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE}" elif [[ -n "${JENKINS_GIT_SSH_PRIVATE_KEY:-}" ]]; then temp_key_file="${ssh_dir}/jenkins_job_key" printf '%b\n' "${JENKINS_GIT_SSH_PRIVATE_KEY}" > "${temp_key_file}" chmod 600 "${temp_key_file}" key_file="${temp_key_file}" fi
if [[ -n "${key_file}" && -n "${JENKINS_GIT_SSH_PASSPHRASE:-}" ]]; then printf '#!/usr/bin/env bash\nprintf %%s %q\n' "${JENKINS_GIT_SSH_PASSPHRASE}" > "${askpass_script}" chmod 700 "${askpass_script}" export SSH_ASKPASS="${askpass_script}" export SSH_ASKPASS_REQUIRE=force export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 export DISPLAY="${DISPLAY:-jenkins-ssh-askpass}" eval "$(ssh-agent -s)" >/dev/null setsid ssh-add "${key_file}" </dev/null >/dev/null export GIT_SSH_COMMAND="ssh ${ssh_options[*]}" elif [[ -n "${key_file}" ]]; then export GIT_SSH_COMMAND="ssh -i ${key_file} -o IdentitiesOnly=yes ${ssh_options[*]}" elif [[ -z "${GIT_SSH_COMMAND:-}" ]]; then export GIT_SSH_COMMAND="ssh ${ssh_options[*]}" fi
repo_dir="${WORKSPACE}/repo" if [[ "${CLEAN_WORKSPACE}" == "true" ]]; then rm -rf "${repo_dir}" fi
clone_args=() if [[ -n "${GIT_BRANCH}" ]]; then clone_args+=(--branch "${GIT_BRANCH}") fi if [[ "${GIT_DEPTH}" != "0" ]]; then clone_args+=(--depth "${GIT_DEPTH}") fi
if [[ ! -d "${repo_dir}/.git" ]]; then git clone "${clone_args[@]}" "${REPO_URL}" "${repo_dir}" else git -C "${repo_dir}" fetch --prune origin "${GIT_BRANCH:-HEAD}" if [[ -n "${GIT_BRANCH}" ]]; then git -C "${repo_dir}" checkout "${GIT_BRANCH}" git -C "${repo_dir}" reset --hard "origin/${GIT_BRANCH}" fi fi
cd "${repo_dir}" if [[ -f android/gradle.properties ]]; then gradle_properties=android/gradle.properties upsert_gradle_property() { local name="$1" local value="$2" if grep -q "^${name}=" "${gradle_properties}"; then sed -i "s|^${name}=.*|${name}=${value}|" "${gradle_properties}" else printf '%s=%s\n' "${name}" "${value}" >> "${gradle_properties}" fi }
upsert_gradle_property "org.gradle.jvmargs" "-Xmx2G -XX:MaxMetaspaceSize=1G -XX:ReservedCodeCacheSize=256m -XX:+HeapDumpOnOutOfMemoryError -Dfile.encoding=UTF-8" upsert_gradle_property "org.gradle.daemon" "false" upsert_gradle_property "org.gradle.vfs.watch" "false" upsert_gradle_property "org.gradle.workers.max" "2" upsert_gradle_property "org.gradle.parallel" "false" upsert_gradle_property "kotlin.daemon.jvmargs" "-Xmx1024m" fi
flutter --version bash -lc "${JOB_COMMAND}"
